sources.snippet: The FastH3 8-Step V2 checkpoint from FastVideo. It generates synchronized video and audio from text with eight transformer forwards. This step-1300 model was trained with data-free DMD2 and VSA-H3 at 80% sparsity. This checkpoint requires FastVideo's VSA-H3 attention backend. Its video scheduler ...
